notes: Ledger is backward-compatible with the current customer service: payment.posted continues to publish amount in major units, while new postings also store amount_cents. The new ledger may be deployed one instance at a time after the additive schema migration; no atomic rollout or event drain is required. It is safe to roll back to the old ledger because amount is retained and new postings dual-write it. If an old instance writes during the mixed rollout, the new ledger reads its legacy amount as a cents fallback.
